verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several in-product AI capabilities that turn customer data into insights and suggestions. New Relic AI lets users ask questions, troubleshoot, and explore telemetry in plain language, and it helps fix queries. Workload AI insights give AI-powered summaries of health, performance trends, and potential issues. AI also flags friction points in session video, and the vulnerability agent drafts step-by-step remediation recommendations. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that these AI insights work well in practice.
